conflicts.subject: iOS 12.4 Public Beta 4: June 11 versus June 12
conflicts.finding: June 11 was the developer seed. Independent same-cycle Gadget Hacks and Forbes reports explicitly place the public seed on June 12; the iCulture row displays June 11.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use 2019-06-12 for the public candidate while preserving the disagreement and requiring independent review.

conflicts.subject: iOS 12.4 begins at Public Beta 2
conflicts.finding: Contemporary reporting explicitly says Public Beta 1 was not released.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Retain PB2 as the first public appearance and do not synthesize PB1.

conflicts.subject: iOS 12.1.2 Public Beta 1 became the 12.1.3 branch
conflicts.finding: The first appearance carried the 12.1.2 label; the first exact 12.1.3 public label was PB2.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Do not relabel the earlier seed as an exact 12.1.3 PB1 event.

conflicts.subject: 13.4.5 Public Beta 1 was renamed into the 13.5 branch
conflicts.finding: The branch began under the 13.4.5 label; exact 13.5 public numbering starts at PB2.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Preserve the legacy label and do not invent exact-label 13.5 PB1 events.

conflicts.subject: 13.5.5 Public Beta 1 was renamed into the 13.6 branch
conflicts.finding: The branch began under the 13.5.5 label; exact 13.6 public numbering starts at PB2.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Preserve the legacy label and do not invent exact-label 13.6 PB1 events.

conflicts.subject: iOS/iPadOS 14.1 had no public-beta cycle
conflicts.finding: Contemporary reporting says beta testing skipped straight to 14.2; 14.1 appears as GM/final only.

conflicts.subject: 14.7 Public Beta 2 was withheld
conflicts.finding: Developer Beta 2 shipped, but public histories jump from PB1 to PB3 after reported SIM failures.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Retain the explicit ordinal gap; do not infer PB2 from the developer event.

conflicts.subject: iOS/iPadOS 14.8 had no beta testing
conflicts.finding: Contemporary final-release coverage explicitly reports that 14.8 was not beta tested.

conflicts.subject: European and Japanese publication dates can be one day later
conflicts.finding: Several rolling pages display the local next-day date for a Pacific-time Apple release.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Normalize appearanceDate to America/Los_Angeles and preserve local dates as source qualifications.

conflicts.subject: 14.6 Public Beta 3: May 10 versus May 11
conflicts.finding: The iMore rolling pages show May 11, while multiple contemporary sources and Pacific publication timing support May 10.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use 2021-05-10 and retain the rolling-page discrepancy.

conflicts.subject: 14.5 Public Beta 3 already exists for both platforms
conflicts.finding: Fresh production reconciliation found exact existing iOS and iPadOS PB3 events.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Exclude both identities from the candidate set; do not duplicate them.

conflicts.subject: iPadOS 14.7 chronology exists but its parent releaseVersion does not
conflicts.finding: PB1, PB3, PB4, and PB5 are established for iPadOS 14.7, but production has no version-ipados-14-7 parent.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Record the sequence in full-sequence-audit.json but create no event candidates until the parent model is separately reviewed and authorized.

conflicts.subject: iPadOS 14.8 final release exists historically but its parent releaseVersion does not
conflicts.finding: The historical final release and no-beta boundary are established, while production lacks version-ipados-14-8.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Handle the parent releaseVersion gap separately; no public-beta event is proposed.
